title: Usage gets a graph and a daily API
summary:
Usage is easier to inspect and export, app authorization accepts longer hostnames, and checkout and site navigation got some housekeeping.

Enter added a Usage tab with daily API request and Pollen graphs, seven-day, 30-day, and all-history views, plus API key and model filters. A new daily usage endpoint groups activity by date, model, and billing source in JSON or CSV; detailed exports now allow up to 50,000 records.

BYOD app authorization now accepts redirect hostnames up to 253 characters as temporary API key names, rather than rejecting names over 32 characters.

A checkout change temporarily disables crypto Pollen purchases and routes pack purchases through Polar. Existing crypto balances are preserved.

daily.title: Explore your usage
daily.text: See daily API requests or Pollen usage in Enter, filter by API key and model, and switch between seven days, 30 days, or all history. Hover for per-model details or download a CSV.

daily.title: Daily usage API
daily.text: Get usage grouped by date, model, and billing source as JSON or CSV from `/api/account/usage/daily`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
